data.text: Parallel agents proved through the real binary in separate processes: 8 writers x 25 tasks in one working tree (200/200 present); 3 worktrees x 4 writers x 20 tasks, committed and merged in one octopus merge with no conflict (441 tasks total, all present); two worktrees claiming KAD-1 -> after the merge one claim and one contested, neither dropped. 13 s locally. Seen to fail: with the store writing <ULID time part>.json instead of <ULID>.json, 182 of 200 survived and the worktree test failed too. Uses sh, so it runs where the test job runs (Linux). Note while running the suite: exporting KADENCE_SOURCE=agent in the shell that runs npm test makes 'without KADENCE_SOURCE an event counts as human' fail - the suite inherits the environment.
